intro.title: Dead Internet
intro.tagline: Everyone is online. Nobody is real.
intro.text: Mara Quinn died on July 2nd. You were at the funeral.

messages.ask: What can you tell me about {name}?

dana.noTrust: I don't know you. Show me you know something first.
dana.strong: "{claim}": two independent sources. I can stand behind that.
dana.weak: "{claim}": one source. That's a lead, not a story. Find me a second, independent one.
dana.none: "{claim}": nothing you've shown me backs this up. Cut it or find something.
dana.bold: "{claim}": that's a big claim. Big claims need more than this.

errors.unknown_topic: You don't know enough about that to ask.
